## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List commands run and results. Identify checks that could not run and why.

- [ ] Formatting, lint, type checks, tests, and build pass.
- [ ] Behavioral changes have meaningful test coverage.
- [ ] Database changes include reviewed migrations and isolated PostgreSQL test evidence, or are not applicable.
- [ ] Runtime/container changes have relevant native and Docker smoke-test evidence, or are not applicable.
- [ ] API/configuration documentation and changelog reflect the change.
- [ ] No secrets, personal tooling, or generated artifacts are included.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe migration, deployment, rollback/data-loss, and compatibility implications. State “None” when none apply.
